connection.changed: The connection was updated or switched. Refresh before trying again.
error.folderPrefixesOverlap: Source and destination folders must not be identical or contain one another.
settings.savedRestart: Settings saved. Hardware acceleration changes take effect after restart.
settings.savedSecretHint: Saved securely. Leave blank to keep using the local saved secret.
settings.checksumAlgorithmHelp: Compatibility mode does not send checksum proactively. AWS S3 can use CRC32; some S3-compatible services require SHA256.
settings.concurrentTransfersHelp: Number of transfer tasks running at the same time, from 1 to 8. This does not affect multipart concurrency inside one large file.
settings.multipartConcurrencyHelp: Used by large file multipart upload, Range download, and multipart copy, from 1 to 16.
settings.chunkSizeHelp: Used for large uploads and Range downloads. The lower layer may increase it to keep part count under 10000.
settings.retryCountHelp: Automatically retries retryable errors such as network timeouts, connection resets, 5xx, and 429.
settings.defaultDownloadFolderHelp: The download folder must exist and be writable. Final files are constrained inside it to prevent path traversal.
settings.localCollisionPolicyHelp: Only affects local downloads. By default, existing files are not overwritten and a safe new file name is generated.
settings.rememberCredentialsHelp: When enabled, encrypted Secret Access Key and Session Token are stored only on this machine.
settings.confirmBeforeDeleteHelp: Shows a confirmation before deleting objects. The main process still validates Bucket and Key.
settings.languageHelp: Choose the language used by the UI, errors, and logs.
settings.compactModeHelp: Reduces list and panel spacing without changing transfer, security, or log behavior.
settings.disableHardwareAccelerationHelp: Enabled by default for smoother scrolling and table rendering. Disable only for GPU driver compatibility issues. Takes effect after restart.
settings.disableGpuShaderDiskCacheHelp: Enabled by default to reduce repeated shader compilation stutter. Disable only when cache write warnings occur. Takes effect after restart.
settings.secureCredentialStorageUnavaila: Secure credential storage is unavailable. Secrets are kept only for this run and cannot be saved locally.
